title: Parts of a Plant Song and Quiz | Grade 1 Science | Little Takhti
description:
Sing along with Takhti! A song about the parts of a plant: roots, stem, leaves and flowers, and the parts we eat, with a quiz inside the song. Shout the answer before the clock runs out! For Grade 1 children (ages 6 to 7). Little Takhti is also on Android.

Free printable worksheets, quizzes and games for this topic: https://littletakhti.netlify.app/class-1-science-parts-of-a-plant-worksheets/

Chapters
0:00 Parts of a plant
0:23 Sing along
1:04 Quiz
2:01 Remember

Little Takhti makes free learning for children in Pakistan, Nursery to Grade 3. https://littletakhti.netlify.app
